raw_sections.experience:
AI Developer | DADB	Feb 2025 — Present
DADB	Bengaluru, Karnataka
AI/LLM Development: Leading the design and implementation of Large Language Model (LLM) applications, including
fine-tuning, embeddings, prompt engineering, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) for enterprise use cases.
Full-Stack Applications: Building end-to-end Application using Node.js for backend, with React/Next.js for frontend integration.
AI Integration & APIs: Exposing models as REST APIs to enable seamless adoption across business units.
Cloud Deployment: Architecting and deploying solutions on AWS and GCP. GitHub Actions for scalable and automated releases.
Data Engineering for AI: Collecting, preprocessing, and managing structured/unstructured datasets to support training, evaluation, and production deployment of AI models.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Working with stakeholders across multiple business units to identify, prioritize, and deliver
impactful AI solutions that improve business efficiency.
Infrastructure & Automation: Implementing Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform) and cloud-native best practices to standardize deployments and reduce system downtime.
Security & Compliance: Embedding security, privacy, and compliance guidelines into AI systems and APIs.
Tech Stack: Python, HuggingFace, LangChain, Java, Node.js, React, Next.js, FastAPI, Flask, PostgreSQL, AWS, GCP, Docker, GitHub Actions, Terraform.
Cloud Engineer | GE Appliances	Jan 2021 — Feb 2025
GE Appliances	Bengaluru, Karnataka
Cloud-Native Development: Designed and developed scalable backend services using Java (Spring Boot) and frontend applications using ReactJS and Next.js to support enterprise-level digital platforms.
Cloud Infrastructure Management: Administered and optimized AWS and GCP resources, ensuring performance, cost efficiency, and security best practices.
CI/CD Automation: Built and maintained automated pipelines with GitHub Actions, reducing release cycle time and ensuring faster deployments with minimal downtime.
RPA Development: Designed and governed UiPath-based RPA architecture, ensuring reliability, scalability, and compliance; standardized automation frameworks across business units.
Data Engineering: Migrated enterprise data warehouse from Vertica to BigQuery, implemented ETL processes with Striim, and built real-time data workflows for analytics.
Analytics & Dashboards: Designed interactive dashboards with Tableau and developed ML-driven insights for business decision-making.
Mobile Development: Built a ride-hailing style app in Flutter, integrating APIs for authentication, payments, and real-time location tracking.
Oracle EBS Development: Automated key business workflows by building concurrent programs in Oracle EBS, improving system efficiency and reporting accuracy.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partnered with product, QA, and operations teams to deliver cloud-based solutions aligned with business needs.
Tech Stack: Java, ReactJS, Next.js, AWS, GCP, Terraform, UiPath, Tableau, Striim, Oracle EBS, PostgreSQL, Python.
Software Engineer | Simplifi Commerce	April 2020 — JAN 2021
Simplifi Commerce	Bengaluru, Karnataka
API Development: Designed and developed REST APIs for dashboards, reporting, data exports, and mobile app features (authentication, payments, and notifications) using Node.js (Express, Koa).
Data Engineering & ETL: Built and maintained ETL pipelines using Singer.io and Meltano for integrating structured and unstructured data sources.
Database Management: Designed schemas and optimized queries for both SQL (PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB)
databases to support high-performance applications.
Cloud & DevOps: Managed AWS infrastructure for application deployment, CI/CD pipelines, and monitoring to ensure availability and scalability.
Frontend Development: Developed customer-facing applications using React, React Native, and Ant Design, ensuring responsive design and seamless user experience.
Cross-Functional Delivery: Collaborated with product managers and clients to align requirements, delivered rapid prototypes, and iterated to meet business objectives.
Tech Stack: Node.js, Python, React, React Native, Ant Design, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, AWS, Singer.io, Meltano.
Software Engineer | AnsrSource	Dec 2017 — April 2020
AnsrSource	Bengaluru, Karnataka
Developed in-house applications to improve workflow and productivity.
Acted as a subject matter expert for Mechanical Engineering subjects.
Demonstrated strong project management skills in executing projects and client interactions.
Worked on Python, JavaScript, and VBA/Macros for productivity improvements and task automation.
